worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.summary: Bite the target and inject venom, with a chance to badly poison it shortly afterward. Existing poison is always intensified. Venom style strengthens the poison; quick style strengthens the bite.
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.use.0: Inject venom with the lightest, most accurate bite
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.use.1: Deepen an already poisoned target into badly poisoned
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.use.2: Hang lasting damage on a high-health target
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.description: The bite deals about %1$s contact and bite damage over a fang radius of %2$s blocks; the target's defence, type matchup and crits are settled on impact.

A beat after the bite (%1$s) the venom seeps in: a %2$s chance to deepen into badly poisoned (plain poison otherwise), lasting %3$s; if the target is already poisoned when the venom seeps in, the deepening is guaranteed.
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.venom.on: Venom style: a higher toxic chance and a longer venom, but a lighter bite, a slower seep and a longer cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.venom.off: Quick style: a heavier bite and a faster seep, but harder to deepen into toxic.
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, cooldown %4$s s, costing %5$s PP.
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.growth.0: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.growth.1: From level %1$s the bite power rises to %2$s and the toxic chance to %3$s.
On: toxic chance +16%%, venom duration x1.25, but bite power x0.92, seep delay +2 ticks and cooldown +4 ticks, for laying on heavier poison. Off (quick style): a heavier bite and a faster seep, but harder to deepen into toxic.
Beyond this distance the user closes in first. The poison fang reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: already poisoned targets rank first, since this bite deepens them into badly poisoned for sure. Off: unpoisoned targets rank first, spreading the venom across more enemies.
worldcombat.skill.poisonfang.description: It lunges along your aim at %1$s blocks/tick for up to about %2$s blocks; the first non-friendly body it meets is bitten, while a blocked or completed lunge that meets none whiffs.
Poison drains health over time, badly poisoned faster; targets immune to poison are not envenomed.
